comment: Pin registry, 011-convention. It is a pin, not an attestation. Both pilot-phase caveats recorded in pilot-01 are RESOLVED as of pilot-02: (1) the evaluator is the released v0.16.0 linux_amd64 binary, archive verified against the release checksums.txt — and its sha256 is byte-identical to the local tag build, which is direct evidence the build is reproducible; (2) harness scripts run under CPython 3.12.11, the same interpreter series-and-patch Study 011 pinned. pilots/2026-08-09-offline-pilot-01 (old toolchain) is retained unchanged.

forge.install: pip install -e <clone at pinned commit> into a CPython 3.11.13 venv
forge.note: Upstream scenario and fixture bytes are vendored under upstream/ with upstream/MANIFEST.sha256; upstream is never modified.

jpack.archiveVerified: matches checksums.txt from the same release
jpack.reproducibleBuild: a local build from the v0.16.0 tag (go1.26.5, CGO_ENABLED=0, -trimpath, goreleaser ldflags) produced this exact binary digest

packs.note: Byte-pinned copies from judgment-pack-runtime v0.16.0 (evaluation corpus packs + two valid-document exception examples). jpack-project/packs/ must stay byte-identical; scenarios/mutations/packs/ must equal a fresh mutate_packs.py derivation.

harnessPython.note: stdlib-only; pilot-01 ran under 3.8.20 (recorded), pilot-02 onward under 3.12.11

cases.note: goldens/EXPECT-CHECK.json must record zero disagreements against the pinned evaluator
